Title: Moonlit Tide Bowl
Body (HTML):
A generous one-of-a-kind bowl with a deep wavy rim that rises and dips all the way round like a ruffle of surf. It's swirled in midnight blue, silver and pearly white, and the swirls ripple across the floor of the bowl like moonlight moving on water.

The pearl shimmer catches the light differently from every side, so it never looks quite the same twice. Big enough to be a centrepiece on its own, or a home for fruit, keys or a pile of pinecones.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Twilight Harbour Bowl
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind straight-sided bowl in soft harbour blue and teal, with ribbons of raspberry drifting round the outside like the last light of evening. A silvery shimmer runs through the whole piece.

A tidy size for a desk, a dresser or a bedside table: rings, hair ties, sweets or loose change.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Sangria Bowl
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind straight-sided bowl in clear resin, with wine-red, plum and olive inks blooming down the walls in soft drips and wisps. A swirl of rose and smoky brown fills the bottom, and a fine gold shimmer catches the light at the rim.

Because it's clear, the light comes straight through the colours. It's lovely on a windowsill, or holding jewellery on a dresser.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Blackberry Agate Tray
Body (HTML):
A large one-of-a-kind serving tray poured to look like a slice of agate. Bands of blackberry purple, charcoal, silver and white sweep across it in layered rings, and the edge is shaped in the irregular outline of real stone. Two matte black handles make it easy to carry.

Use it for serving, as a vanity tray for perfume and jewellery, or on a coffee table to corral candles and remotes. Wipe clean; not for the dishwasher, and not for hot dishes.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Copper Peacock Serving Board
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind paddle board with a poured resin top in warm copper, laced with glittering copper veins. Tucked into the cells between the veins are little flashes of teal, blue, green and red, like the eyes on a peacock's tail. The colour carries over the handle and round the hanging hole.

The resin is food-safe, so it's ready for cheese, charcuterie or bread. It's a serving board, not a chopping board, so please don't cut on it. Wipe clean; not for the dishwasher.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Copper Lagoon Tealight Holder
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind rounded tealight holder in cobalt blue, lime green and soft pink, scattered with chunky flakes of copper all around the rim. It's bright and cheerful even unlit, and a little glow in the well makes the copper sparkle.

Please use a flameless LED tealight, or a tealight in its own little glass cup. Resin softens with heat, so no bare flame against it.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Mermaid Scale Tealight Holder
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind rounded tealight holder in mossy green, teal and violet with a gold sheen, set with silvery flakes that catch the light like scales. The flakes carry right down into the well, so they glitter when it's lit.

Please use a flameless LED tealight, or a tealight in its own little glass cup. Resin softens with heat, so no bare flame against it.

Body (HTML):

Please use a flameless LED tealight, or a tealight in its own little glass cup. Resin softens with heat, so no bare flame against it.

Title: Dandelion Wish Tealight Holder
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind rounded tealight holder in crystal-clear resin, with real dandelion seeds floating all through it, each one with its feathery parachute still open. It looks as if someone made a wish and the seeds were caught mid-air.

Clear pours like this take extra care, because any flaw shows. With a light in the well, the seeds glow.

Please use a flameless LED tealight, or a tealight in its own little glass cup. Resin softens with heat, so no bare flame against it.

Title: Starfish Cove Tealight Holder
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind square tealight holder in clear sea-glass turquoise, with real little starfish set right through it. Look down into the well and a big knobbly starfish sits underneath, looking back up at you.

A sweet piece for a beach lover, a bathroom shelf or a cottage windowsill.

Please use a flameless LED tealight, or a tealight in its own little glass cup. Resin softens with heat, so no bare flame against it.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Seashell Lantern
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind tall square tealight holder like a little aquarium. Real seashells are layered right up through clear turquoise resin: scallops, clams, a spiral snail shell and a tall auger, all resting on a bed of sand and tiny shells at the bottom.

Shells float, so a piece like this can't be poured in one go. It was built up over three separate pours, each left to cure before the next layer of shells went in. It's lovely lit, and just as nice sitting in a sunny window.

Please use a flameless LED tealight, or a tealight in its own little glass cup. Resin softens with heat, so no bare flame against it.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Garnet Thinkers — Set of 3
Body (HTML):
A set of three seated thinker figures in deep garnet red, marbled with copper, gold and flashes of cobalt blue. The metallic swirls follow the curves of each figure, and touches of gold catch the light on their heads and shoulders.

They look great together on a shelf or mantel, or split them up across a room.

Title: Moonflower Geode — Set of 4
Body (HTML):
A set of four geode coasters in smoky grey, veined with white like the petals of a flower opening at night. Each one has a heart of glittering gold crystals and an edge of sparkly white crystal, finished by hand.
